item.text: I’m going to inspect the Embry contact sheet first, then use only the built-in `image_gen` tool with that file as the identity reference. After generation I’ll place the PNG and receipt at the exact requested paths.

The reference shows Embry with tied-back brown hair, warm light-tan skin, expressive brown eyes, a softly rounded jaw, and a navy top. I’m generating the single 16:9 storyboard frame now with that image as the mandatory identity input.

The generated image came back at the requested 16:9 framing and includes Embry foreground, the bowl, cardboard kitchen, afghan tablecloth, recipe note, and grandmother screen. I’m copying that PNG to the required frame path, then I’ll compute the receipt directly from the saved bytes.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

URL=""
NAME=""
WAIT_SECS="2"
CWD_OVERRIDE=""
TAB_ID=""
OUTPUT_ROOT="${CODEX_UI_VERIFICATION_DIR:-/tmp/codex-ui-verification}"

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --url) URL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --name) NAME="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --wait) WAIT_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --cwd) CWD_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --tab-id) TAB_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --output-root) OUTPUT_ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "Unknown arg: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

if [[ -z "$URL" ]]; then
  echo "Usage: ~/.codex/hooks/verify-ui-cdp.sh --url <target-url> [--name <surface>] [--tab-id <exact-tab>] [--wait <seconds>] [--cwd <repo>]" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if [[ -n "$CWD_OVERRIDE" ]]; then
  WORKDIR="$CWD_OVERRIDE"
else
  WORKDIR="$PWD"
fi

if git -C "$WORKDIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ROOT="$(git -C "$WORKDIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
else
  ROOT="$WORKDIR"
fi

if [[ -z "$NAME" ]]; then
  NAME="$(basename "$ROOT")"
fi
SAFE_NAME="$(printf '%s' "$NAME" | tr ' /:#' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_.-')"
STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
OUT_BASE="$OUTPUT_ROOT/$(basename "$ROOT")"
OUT_DIR="$OUT_BASE/$SAFE_NAME"
LATEST="$OUT_BASE/latest.json"
REPO_LATEST="$ROOT/.codex/ui-verification/latest.json"
REPO_SURFACE_LATEST="$ROOT/.codex/ui-verification/$SAFE_NAME.latest.json"
SHOT="$OUT_DIR/$STAMP.png"
READ_JSON="$OUT_DIR/$STAMP.read.json"
META_JSON="$OUT_DIR/$STAMP.meta.json"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" "$(dirname "$LATEST")" "$(dirname "$REPO_LATEST")"

AUTH_SURF="${SURF_RUN_SH:-/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf/run.sh}"
AUTHENTICATED_SURF=0
RESOLVED_TAB_ID=""

SURF_DIR=""
for candidate in \
  "/home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/surf" \
  "$ROOT/.pi/skills/surf"; do
  if [[ -x "$candidate/run.sh" && -x "$candidate/.venv/bin/python" && -f "$candidate/cdp_controller.py" ]]; then
    SURF_DIR="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done

if [[ -z "$SURF_DIR" ]]; then
  echo "Could not find the surf CDP skill. Expected /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/surf or <repo>/.pi/skills/surf" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$URL" == https://chatgpt.com/* ]]; then
  if [[ ! -x "$AUTH_SURF" ]]; then
    echo "Authenticated Surf runtime is unavailable: $AUTH_SURF" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  tab_list_json="$("$AUTH_SURF" tab.list --json)"
  RESOLVED_TAB_ID="$(TAB_LIST_JSON="$tab_list_json" EXPECTED_URL="$URL" REQUESTED_TAB_ID="$TAB_ID" python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
tabs = json.loads(os.environ["TAB_LIST_JSON"])
expected = os.environ["EXPECTED_URL"].rstrip("/")
requested = os.environ.get("REQUESTED_TAB_ID", "")
matches = []
for tab in tabs:
    tab_id = str(tab.get("id") or tab.get("tab_id") or "")
    url = str(tab.get("url") or "").rstrip("/")
    if url == expected and (not requested or tab_id == requested):
        matches.append(tab_id)
if len(matches) != 1:
    print(f"expected one authenticated exact-URL tab, found {len(matches)}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print(matches[0])
')" || exit 1
  "$AUTH_SURF" screenshot --output "$SHOT" --tab-id "$RESOLVED_TAB_ID" --full >/dev/null
  surf_read="$("$AUTH_SURF" read --tab-id "$RESOLVED_TAB_ID" --json)"
  surf_identity="$("$AUTH_SURF" js "return JSON.stringify({url:location.href,title:document.title})" --no-activate --tab-id "$RESOLVED_TAB_ID")"
  SURF_READ="$surf_read" SURF_IDENTITY="$surf_identity" READ_JSON="$READ_JSON" python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path

def decode(value):
    parsed = json.loads(value)
    return json.loads(parsed) if isinstance(parsed, str) and parsed.startswith("{") else parsed

identity = decode(os.environ["SURF_IDENTITY"])
page_content = decode(os.environ["SURF_READ"])
Path(os.environ["READ_JSON"]).write_text(json.dumps({
    "url": identity.get("url"),
    "title": identity.get("title"),
    "pageContent": page_content,
    "transport": "authenticated_surf_exact_tab",
}, indent=2) + "\n")
PY
  AUTHENTICATED_SURF=1
elif node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  URL="$URL" SHOT="$SHOT" WAIT_SECS="$WAIT_SECS" node - <<'NODE'
const { chromium } = require('playwright');

(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
  await page.goto(process.env.URL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(Number(process.env.WAIT_SECS || '2') * 1000);
  await page.screenshot({ path: process.env.SHOT, fullPage: true });
  await browser.close();
})().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
NODE
else
  "$SURF_DIR/run.sh" cdp start --headless >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  CDP_PORT="${CDP_PORT:-9222}" "$SURF_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$SURF_DIR/cdp_controller.py" go "$URL" >/dev/null
  CDP_PORT="${CDP_PORT:-9222}" "$SURF_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$SURF_DIR/cdp_controller.py" wait "$WAIT_SECS" >/dev/null
  CDP_PORT="${CDP_PORT:-9222}" "$SURF_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$SURF_DIR/cdp_controller.py" snap --output "$SHOT" >/dev/null
fi

if python3 - "$SHOT" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from PIL import Image

path = Path(sys.argv[1])
if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
    raise SystemExit(0)
image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
extrema = image.getextrema()
is_blank = all(low == high for low, high in extrema)
raise SystemExit(0 if is_blank else 1)
PY
then
  if command -v google-chrome-stable >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    google-chrome-stable \
      --headless \
      --disable-gpu \
      --no-sandbox \
      --window-size=1440,861 \
      --virtual-time-budget=$(( WAIT_SECS * 1000 + 3000 )) \
      --screenshot="$SHOT" \
      "$URL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi

if python3 - "$SHOT" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from PIL import Image

path = Path(sys.argv[1])
if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
    print(f"Screenshot missing or empty: {path}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
extrema = image.getextrema()
if all(low == high for low, high in extrema):
    print(f"Screenshot is blank: {path}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
then
  :
else
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$AUTHENTICATED_SURF" -eq 1 ]]; then
  :
elif node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  URL="$URL" READ_JSON="$READ_JSON" WAIT_SECS="$WAIT_SECS" node - <<'NODE'
const { chromium } = require('playwright');

(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
  await page.goto(process.env.URL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(Number(process.env.WAIT_SECS || '2') * 1000);
  const elements = await page.locator('body *').evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.slice(0, 500).map((node, index) => ({
    index,
    tag: node.tagName.toLowerCase(),
    text: (node.innerText || node.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 500),
    qid: node.getAttribute('data-qid'),
    testid: node.getAttribute('data-testid'),
    role: node.getAttribute('role'),
  })).filter((item) => item.text || item.qid || item.testid || item.role));
  const payload = {
    url: page.url(),
    title: await page.title(),
    text: await page.locator('body').innerText({ timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => ''),
    elements,
  };
  require('fs').writeFileSync(process.env.READ_JSON, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + '\n');
  await browser.close();
})().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
NODE
else
  CDP_PORT="${CDP_PORT:-9222}" "$SURF_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$SURF_DIR/cdp_controller.py" read --json --filter all > "$READ_JSON"

item.text: The generator saved a 16:9 PNG at `1672x941`, so I’m normalizing the final frame file to the requested `1536x864` before hashing it. The receipt will reflect the final bytes at the target path, not the intermediate generated file.

I found ImageMagick available, so I’m using it only for deterministic PNG resizing to the requested dimensions. The image generation itself has already been done through the built-in `image_gen` tool only.
The target PNG is now `1536x864`, and the SHA-256 for the final bytes is `43cfbcc6774f9bd5138b10a742202b3cea9a8c392bf2f02fd9924192edaa05e8`. I’m writing the receipt JSON next with those exact values.
I’m creating the receipt as a small JSON artifact in the same frame directory. It records the built-in tool/OAuth path as the auth source and the final file hash.
